content: This product information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. It is not intended to replace the advice of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Taking MAO inhibitors with this medication may result in a severe, potentially fatal drug interaction. Avoid using MAO inhibitors (e.g., isocarboxazid, linezolid, metaxalone, methylene blue, moclobemide, phenelzine, procarbazine, rasagiline, safinamide, selegiline, tranylcypromine) during treatment with this medication. Most MAO inhibitors should also not be taken for two weeks before starting this medication. Some products may contain ingredients that can elevate your heart rate or blood pressure. Caffeine can amplify the side effects of this medication. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Do not share this medication with others. Appetite suppressants should not be used as a substitute for a proper diet. Laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., blood pressure, heart, or kidney function) may be conducted while you are taking this medication. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose. Take your next dose at the regular scheduled time. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in June 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
